31924 | #### src/features/portal/auth/portal-auth.ts
31925 |
31926 | ~~~text
31927 | export const PORTAL_AUTH_STATUSES = [
31928 |   "unknown",
31929 |   "restoring",
31930 |   "anonymous",
31931 |   "authenticated",
31932 |   "denied",
31933 | ] as const;
31934 |
31935 | export type PortalAuthStatus = (typeof PORTAL_AUTH_STATUSES)[number];
31936 |
31937 | export type PortalClientIdentity = Readonly<{
31938 |   clienteId: string;
31939 |   empresaId: string;
31940 |   sid: string;
31941 | }>;
31942 |
31943 | export type PortalAuthState = Readonly<{
31944 |   status: PortalAuthStatus;
31945 |   identity: PortalClientIdentity | null;
31946 | }>;
31947 |
31948 | export const PORTAL_AUTH_INITIAL_STATE: PortalAuthState = {
31949 |   status: "unknown",
31950 |   identity: null,
31951 | };
31952 |
31953 | export type PortalAuthAction =
31954 |   | { type: "restore" }
31955 |   | { type: "anonymous" }
31956 |   | { type: "authenticated"; identity: PortalClientIdentity }
31957 |   | { type: "denied" }
31958 |   | { type: "clear" };
31959 |
31960 | export function portalAuthReducer(
31961 |   state: PortalAuthState,
31962 |   action: PortalAuthAction,
31963 | ): PortalAuthState {
31964 |   switch (action.type) {
31965 |     case "restore":
31966 |       return { status: "restoring", identity: null };
31967 |     case "anonymous":
31968 |       return { status: "anonymous", identity: null };
31969 |     case "authenticated":
31970 |       return { status: "authenticated", identity: action.identity };
31971 |     case "denied":
31972 |       return { status: "denied", identity: null };
31973 |     case "clear":
31974 |       return { status: "anonymous", identity: null };
31975 |     default:
31976 |       return state;
31977 |   }
31978 | }
31979 |
31980 | export function canUsePortalPrivateQueries(
31981 |   state: Pick<PortalAuthState, "status">,
31982 | ): boolean {
31983 |   return state.status === "authenticated";
31984 | }

32159 | };
32160 |
32161 | const PortalAuthContext = createContext<PortalAuthContextValue | null>(null);
32162 |
32163 | type PortalAuthProviderProps = {
32164 |   children: ReactNode;
32165 |   initialState?: PortalAuthState;
32166 | };
32167 |
32168 | export function PortalAuthProvider({
32169 |   children,
32170 |   initialState = PORTAL_AUTH_INITIAL_STATE,
32171 | }: PortalAuthProviderProps) {
32172 |   const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(portalAuthReducer, initialState);
32173 |
32174 |   const beginRestore = useCallback(() => {
32175 |     dispatch({ type: "restore" });
32176 |   }, []);
32177 |
32178 |   const markAnonymous = useCallback(() => {
32179 |     dispatch({ type: "anonymous" });
32180 |   }, []);
32181 |
32182 |   const markAuthenticated = useCallback(
32183 |     (identity: PortalClientIdentity) => {
32184 |       dispatch({ type: "authenticated", identity });
32185 |     },
32186 |     [],
32187 |   );
32188 |
32189 |   const markDenied = useCallback(() => {
32190 |     dispatch({ type: "denied" });
32191 |   }, []);
32192 |
32193 |   const clearSession = useCallback(() => {
32194 |     dispatch({ type: "clear" });
32195 |   }, []);
32196 |
32197 |   const value = useMemo<PortalAuthContextValue>(
32198 |     () => ({
32199 |       ...state,
32200 |       canUsePrivateQueries: canUsePortalPrivateQueries(state),
32201 |       beginRestore,
32202 |       markAnonymous,
32203 |       markAuthenticated,
32204 |       markDenied,
32205 |       clearSession,
32206 |     }),
32207 |     [
32208 |       beginRestore,
32209 |       clearSession,
32210 |       markAnonymous,
32211 |       markAuthenticated,
32212 |       markDenied,
32213 |       state,
32214 |     ],
32215 |   );
32216 |
32217 |   return (
32218 |     <PortalAuthContext.Provider value={value}>
32219 |       {children}
32220 |     </PortalAuthContext.Provider>
32221 |   );
32222 | }
32223 |
32224 | export function usePortalAuth(): PortalAuthContextValue {
32225 |   const context = useContext(PortalAuthContext);
32226 |
32227 |   if (!context) {
32228 |     throw new Error("usePortalAuth deve ser utilizado dentro de PortalAuthProvider.");
32229 |   }
32230 |
32231 |   return context;
32232 | }
32233 |
32234 | type PortalAuthBoundaryProps = {
32235 |   children: ReactNode;
32236 |   restoringFallback?: ReactNode;
32237 |   anonymousFallback?: ReactNode;
32238 |   deniedFallback?: ReactNode;
32239 | };
32240 |
32241 | export function PortalAuthBoundary({
32242 |   children,
32243 |   restoringFallback = null,
32244 |   anonymousFallback = null,
32245 |   deniedFallback = null,
32246 | }: PortalAuthBoundaryProps) {
32247 |   const { status } = usePortalAuth();
32248 |
32249 |   if (status === "unknown" || status === "restoring") {
32250 |     return restoringFallback;
32251 |   }
32252 |
32253 |   if (status === "anonymous") {
32254 |     return anonymousFallback;
32255 |   }
32256 |
32257 |   if (status === "denied") {
32258 |     return deniedFallback;
32259 |   }
32260 |
32261 |   return children;
32262 | }
32263 | ~~~

32949 | export type PortalNavigationItem = {
32950 |   href: string;
32951 |   label: string;
32952 |   enabled?: boolean;
32953 | };
32954 |
32955 | export function isSafePortalHref(href: string): boolean {
32956 |   return href === "/portal" || href.startsWith("/portal/");
32957 | }
32958 |
32959 | export function isPortalNavigationItemActive(
32960 |   href: string,
32961 |   activePath: string,
32962 | ): boolean {
32963 |   if (href === "/portal") {
32964 |     return activePath === "/portal";
32965 |   }
32966 |
32967 |   return activePath === href || activePath.startsWith(`${href}/`);

33366 | #### src/features/portal/query/portal-query.ts
33367 |
33368 | ~~~text
33369 | import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
33370 |
33371 | import type { PortalAuthStatus } from "../auth/portal-auth";
33372 |
33373 | export const portalQueryKeys = {
33374 |   all: ["portal"] as const,
33375 |
33376 |   public: () => [...portalQueryKeys.all, "public"] as const,
33377 |
33378 |   private: () => [...portalQueryKeys.all, "private"] as const,
33379 |
33380 |   publicResource: (
33381 |     resource: string,
33382 |     ...parts: readonly unknown[]
33383 |   ) => [...portalQueryKeys.public(), resource, ...parts] as const,
33384 |
33385 |   privateResource: (
33386 |     resource: string,
33387 |     ...parts: readonly unknown[]
33388 |   ) => [...portalQueryKeys.private(), resource, ...parts] as const,
33389 | };
33390 |
33391 | export function portalQueryEnabled(
33392 |   status: PortalAuthStatus,
33393 |   requiresAuthentication: boolean,
33394 | ): boolean {
33395 |   if (requiresAuthentication) {
33396 |     return status === "authenticated";
33397 |   }
33398 |
33399 |   return (
33400 |     status === "anonymous" ||
33401 |     status === "authenticated" ||
33402 |     status === "denied"
33403 |   );
33404 | }
33405 |
33406 | export function cleanupPortalPrivateQueries(
33407 |   queryClient: QueryClient,
33408 | ): void {
33409 |   void queryClient.cancelQueries({
33410 |     queryKey: portalQueryKeys.private(),
33411 |   });
33412 |
33413 |   queryClient.removeQueries({
33414 |     queryKey: portalQueryKeys.private(),
33415 |   });
33416 | }
33417 |
33418 | export type PortalAccessTransition = "anonymous" | "denied";
33419 |
33420 | export function portalAccessTransitionFromStatus(
33421 |   status: number,
33422 | ): PortalAccessTransition | null {
33423 |   if (status === 401) {
33424 |     return "anonymous";
33425 |   }
33426 |
33427 |   if (status === 403) {
33428 |     return "denied";
33429 |   }
33430 |
33431 |   return null;
33432 | }
33433 |
33434 | export function handlePortalAccessError(
33435 |   queryClient: QueryClient,
33436 |   status: number,
33437 |   onTransition: (transition: PortalAccessTransition) => void,
33438 | ): boolean {
33439 |   const transition = portalAccessTransitionFromStatus(status);
33440 |
33441 |   if (!transition) {
33442 |     return false;
33443 |   }
33444 |
33445 |   cleanupPortalPrivateQueries(queryClient);
33446 |   onTransition(transition);
33447 |
33448 |   return true;
33449 | }
33450 | ~~~

33542 |
33543 | ~~~text
33544 | "use client";
33545 |
33546 | import { useCallback } from "react";
33547 | import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
33548 |
33549 | import { usePortalAuth } from "../auth/portal-auth-context";
33550 | import {
33551 |   handlePortalAccessError,
33552 |   portalQueryEnabled,
33553 | } from "./portal-query";
33554 |
33555 | export function usePortalQueryGate(
33556 |   requiresAuthentication = true,
33557 | ): boolean {
33558 |   const { status } = usePortalAuth();
33559 |
33560 |   return portalQueryEnabled(status, requiresAuthentication);
33561 | }
33562 |
33563 | export function usePortalAccessErrorHandler() {
33564 |   const queryClient = useQueryClient();
33565 |   const { markAnonymous, markDenied } = usePortalAuth();
33566 |
33567 |   return useCallback(
33568 |     (status: number): boolean =>
33569 |       handlePortalAccessError(queryClient, status, (transition) => {
33570 |         if (transition === "anonymous") {
33571 |           markAnonymous();
33572 |           return;
33573 |         }
33574 |
33575 |         markDenied();
33576 |       }),
33577 |     [markAnonymous, markDenied, queryClient],
33578 |   );
33579 | }

33655 | #### src/features/portal/security/portal-safe-return-to.ts
33656 |
33657 | ~~~text
33658 | const PORTAL_ORIGIN = "https://portal.invalid";
33659 | const DEFAULT_PORTAL_RETURN_TO = "/portal";
33660 | const CONTROL_CHARACTERS = /[\u0000-\u001f\u007f]/;
33661 |
33662 | function resolveSafePortalPath(
33663 |   value: unknown,
33664 | ): string | null {
33665 |   if (typeof value !== "string") {
33666 |     return null;
33667 |   }
33668 |
33669 |   const candidate = value.trim();
33670 |
33671 |   if (
33672 |     candidate.length === 0 ||
33673 |     candidate.length > 512 ||
33674 |     CONTROL_CHARACTERS.test(candidate) ||
33675 |     /\s/.test(candidate) ||
33676 |     candidate.includes("\\") ||
33677 |     candidate.includes("%") ||
33678 |     candidate.includes("?") ||
33679 |     candidate.includes("#") ||
33680 |     !candidate.startsWith("/") ||
33681 |     candidate.startsWith("//") ||
33682 |     /^[a-z][a-z\d+.-]*:/i.test(candidate)
33683 |   ) {
33684 |     return null;
33685 |   }
33686 |
33687 |   let parsed: URL;
33688 |
33689 |   try {
33690 |     parsed = new URL(candidate, PORTAL_ORIGIN);
33691 |   } catch {
33692 |     return null;
33693 |   }
33694 |
33695 |   if (
33696 |     parsed.origin !== PORTAL_ORIGIN ||
33697 |     parsed.username ||
33698 |     parsed.password ||
33699 |     parsed.port ||
33700 |     parsed.search ||
33701 |     parsed.hash
33702 |   ) {
33703 |     return null;
33704 |   }
33705 |
33706 |   if (
33707 |     parsed.pathname !== "/portal" &&
33708 |     !parsed.pathname.startsWith("/portal/")
33709 |   ) {
33710 |     return null;
33711 |   }
33712 |
33713 |   return parsed.pathname;
33714 | }
33715 |
33716 | export function isSafePortalReturnTo(value: unknown): boolean {
33717 |   return resolveSafePortalPath(value) !== null;
33718 | }
33719 |
33720 | export function sanitizePortalReturnTo(
33721 |   value: unknown,
33722 |   fallback = DEFAULT_PORTAL_RETURN_TO,
33723 | ): string {
33724 |   return (
33725 |     resolveSafePortalPath(value) ??
33726 |     resolveSafePortalPath(fallback) ??
33727 |     DEFAULT_PORTAL_RETURN_TO
33728 |   );
33729 | }
33730 | ~~~

39815 |         validateRestore: this.pathStatus('scripts/backup/validate-restore.ps1'),
39816 |       },
39817 |       scheduler: {

39843 |     const uploads = this.limparUploadsTemp();
39844 |     const jobs = this.registrarLimpezaJobsAntigos();
39845 |     const payload = { timestamp: new Date().toISOString(), results: [sessoes, uploads, jobs] };
39846 |

39871 |
39872 |   private async limparSessoesAntigas() {
39873 |     const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - 90 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
39874 |     let deletedCount = 0;
39875 |     const delegate = (this.prisma as any).sessao;
39876 |
39877 |     if (delegate?.deleteMany) {
39878 |       const result = await delegate.deleteMany({
39879 |         where: {
39880 |           OR: [
39881 |             { expiraEm: { lt: cutoff } },
39882 |             { revogada: true, updatedAt: { lt: cutoff } },
39883 |           ],
39884 |         },
39885 |       });
39886 |
39887 |       deletedCount = result?.count ?? 0;
39888 |     }
39889 |
39890 |     const payload = {
39891 |       job: 'limpeza_sessoes_expiradas',
39892 |       status: 'SUCESSO',
39893 |       cutoff: cutoff.toISOString(),
39894 |       deletedCount,
39895 |     };
39896 |
39897 |     this.appendAutomationLog(payload);
39898 |     await this.registrarAuditoria(
39899 |       'LIMPEZA_AUTOMATICA',
39900 |       'Sessoes expiradas/revogadas antigas limpas.',
39901 |       payload,
39902 |     );
39903 |
39904 |     return payload;
39905 |   }
39906 |
39907 |   private limparUploadsTemp() {
39908 |     const tempDir = resolve(this.projectRoot, 'uploads', 'temp');
39909 |     const cutoffMs = Date.now() - 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
39910 |     let removedCount = 0;
39911 |
39912 |     if (existsSync(tempDir)) {
39913 |       for (const item of readdirSync(tempDir)) {
39914 |         const itemPath = join(tempDir, item);
39915 |
39916 |         if (statSync(itemPath).mtimeMs < cutoffMs) {
39917 |           rmSync(itemPath, { recursive: true, force: true });
39918 |           removedCount++;
39919 |         }
39920 |       }
39921 |     }
39922 |
39923 |     const payload = {
39924 |       job: 'limpeza_uploads_temp',
39925 |       status: 'SUCESSO',
39926 |       retentionDays: 7,
39927 |       removedCount,
39928 |     };
39929 |
39930 |     this.appendAutomationLog(payload);
39931 |     void this.registrarAuditoria(
39932 |       'LIMPEZA_AUTOMATICA',
39933 |       'Uploads temporarios antigos limpos.',
39934 |       payload,
39935 |     );
39936 |
39937 |     return payload;
39938 |   }
39939 |
39940 |   private registrarLimpezaJobsAntigos() {
39941 |     const payload = {
39942 |       job: 'limpeza_jobs_antigos',
39943 |       status: 'SIMULADO',
39944 |       retentionCompletedJobsDays: 30,
39945 |       retentionFailedJobsDays: 90,
39946 |       message: 'Estrutura de retencao de jobs antigos preparada para integracao BullMQ especifica.',
39947 |     };
39948 |
39949 |     this.appendAutomationLog(payload);
39950 |     void this.registrarAuditoria(
39951 |       'RETENCAO_EXECUTADA',
39952 |       'Retencao de jobs antigos registrada em modo scheduler-ready.',
39953 |       payload,
39954 |     );
39955 |
39956 |     return payload;
39957 |   }

39959 |   private registrarOuExecutarBackup(job: BackupJobName) {
39960 |     if (!this.isExecutionEnabled()) {
39961 |       return this.registrarExecucaoSimulada(job);
39962 |     }
39963 |
39964 |     return this.executarBackupReal(job);
39965 |   }
39966 |
39967 |   private registrarExecucaoSimulada(job: BackupJobName) {
39968 |     const payload = {
39969 |       job,
39970 |       status: 'SIMULADO',
39971 |       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
39972 |       executionEnabled: this.isExecutionEnabled(),
39973 |       message: 'Backup registrado em modo seguro. Execucao real exige BACKUP_EXECUTION_ENABLED=true.',
39974 |       scripts: this.scriptsForJob(job),
39975 |     };
39976 |
39977 |     this.appendAutomationLog(payload);
39978 |
39979 |     return payload;
39980 |   }
39981 |
39982 |   private executarBackupReal(job: BackupJobName) {
39983 |     const scripts = this.scriptsForJob(job);
39984 |     const startedAt = Date.now();
39985 |     const results: BackupScriptResult[] = [];
39986 |
39987 |     for (const script of scripts) {
39988 |       results.push(this.executarScriptPowerShell(script));
39989 |     }
39990 |
39991 |     const payload = {
39992 |       job,
39993 |       status: 'SUCESSO',
39994 |       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
39995 |       executionEnabled: true,
39996 |       durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
39997 |       scripts,
39998 |       results,
39999 |     };
40000 |
40001 |     this.appendAutomationLog(payload);
40002 |
40003 |     return payload;
40004 |   }
40005 |
40006 |   private executarScriptPowerShell(script: string): BackupScriptResult {
40007 |     const scriptPath = resolve(this.projectRoot, script);
40008 |
40009 |     if (!existsSync(scriptPath)) {
40010 |       throw new Error(`Script de backup nao encontrado: ${script}`);
40011 |     }
40012 |
40013 |     try {
40014 |       const output = execFileSync(
40015 |         'powershell',
40016 |         ['-ExecutionPolicy', 'Bypass', '-File', scriptPath],
40017 |         {
40018 |           cwd: this.projectRoot,
40019 |           encoding: 'utf8',
40020 |           stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'],
40021 |           timeout: Number(process.env.BACKUP_SCRIPT_TIMEOUT_MS ?? 15 * 60 * 1000),
40022 |         },
40023 |       );
40024 |
40025 |       return {
40026 |         script,
40027 |         status: 'SUCESSO',
40028 |         output: this.truncateOutput(output),
40029 |       };
40030 |     } catch (error) {
40031 |       const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
40032 |       const payload = {
40033 |         script,
40034 |         status: 'FALHA',
40035 |         error: message,
40036 |       } satisfies BackupScriptResult;
40037 |
40038 |       this.appendAutomationLog({
40039 |         evento: 'BACKUP_SCRIPT_FALHA',
40040 |         ...payload,
40041 |       });
40042 |
40043 |       throw new Error(`Falha ao executar script de backup ${script}: ${message}`);
40044 |     }
40045 |   }
40046 |
40047 |   private truncateOutput(output: string) {
40048 |     const clean = output.trim();
40049 |
40050 |     if (clean.length <= 2000) {
40051 |       return clean;
40052 |     }
40053 |
40054 |     return clean.slice(0, 2000) + '...';
40055 |   }
40056 |
40057 |   private scriptsForJob(job: BackupJobName) {
40058 |     if (job === 'backup_postgres_diario') {
40059 |       return ['scripts/backup/postgres-backup.ps1'];
40060 |     }
40061 |
40062 |     if (job === 'backup_uploads_diario') {
40063 |       return ['scripts/uploads/uploads-backup.ps1'];
40064 |     }
40065 |
40066 |     return [
40067 |       'scripts/backup/postgres-backup.ps1',
40068 |       'scripts/uploads/uploads-backup.ps1',
40069 |       'scripts/backup/redis-backup.ps1',
40070 |     ];
40071 |   }
40072 |

40080 |

40083 |       }
40084 |
40085 |       await delegate.create({

40102 |       });

40105 |     }
40106 |   }

40195 | import { Injectable, LoggerService } from '@nestjs/common';

40198 |
40199 | type StructuredLogLevel =
40200 |   | 'info'
40201 |   | 'error'
40202 |   | 'warn'
40203 |   | 'debug'
40204 |   | 'verbose'
40205 |   | 'fatal';
40206 |
40207 | type JsonValue =
40208 |   | string

40224 |     this.write('error', message, context, trace);

40230 |
40231 |   debug(message: unknown, context?: string): void {
40232 |     this.write('debug', message, context);
40233 |   }
40234 |
40235 |   verbose(message: unknown, context?: string): void {
40236 |     this.write('verbose', message, context);
40237 |   }
40238 |
40239 |   fatal(message: unknown, context?: string): void {
40240 |     this.write('fatal', message, context);
40241 |   }
40242 |
40243 |   private write(
40244 |     level: StructuredLogLevel,
40245 |     message: unknown,
40246 |     context?: string,
40247 |     trace?: string,
40248 |   ): void {
40249 |     const requestContext = this.requestContext.getContext();
40250 |
40251 |     const payload: Record<string, JsonValue | undefined> = {
40252 |       timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
40253 |       level,
40254 |       service: 'beauty-core-api',
40255 |       environment: process.env.NODE_ENV ?? 'development',
40256 |       context: context ?? null,
40257 |       message: this.normalizeMessage(message),
40258 |       requestId: requestContext?.requestId ?? null,
40259 |       correlationId: requestContext?.correlationId ?? null,
40260 |       empresaId: requestContext?.empresaId ?? null,
40261 |       usuarioId: requestContext?.usuarioId ?? null,
40262 |       clienteId: requestContext?.clienteId ?? null,
40263 |       role: requestContext?.role ?? null,
40264 |       method: requestContext?.method ?? null,
40265 |       route: requestContext?.route ?? null,
40266 |       ip: requestContext?.ip ?? null,
40267 |       userAgent: requestContext?.userAgent ?? null,
40268 |       pid: process.pid,
40269 |     };
40270 |
40271 |     if (trace) {
40272 |       payload.trace = trace;
40273 |     }
40274 |
40275 |     const line = JSON.stringify(this.removeUndefined(payload));
40276 |
40277 |     if (level === 'error' || level === 'fatal') {
40278 |       console.error(line);
40279 |       return;
40280 |     }
40281 |
40282 |     if (level === 'warn') {
40283 |       console.warn(line);
40284 |       return;
40285 |     }
40286 |
40287 |     console.log(line);
40288 |   }
40289 |
40290 |   private normalizeMessage(message: unknown): JsonValue {
40291 |     if (message instanceof Error) {
40292 |       return {
40293 |         name: message.name,
40294 |         message: message.message,
40295 |         stack: message.stack ?? null,
40296 |       };
40297 |     }
40298 |
40299 |     if (typeof message === 'string') {
40300 |       return message;
40301 |     }
40302 |
40303 |     return this.safeJson(message);
40304 |   }
40305 |
40306 |   private safeJson(
40307 |     value: unknown,
40308 |     depth = 0,
40309 |     seen = new WeakSet<object>(),
40310 |   ): JsonValue {
40311 |     if (value === null || value === undefined) {
40312 |       return null;
40313 |     }
40314 |
40315 |     if (typeof value === 'string') {
40316 |       return value;
40317 |     }
40318 |
40319 |     if (typeof value === 'number') {
40320 |       return Number.isFinite(value) ? value : String(value);
40321 |     }
40322 |
40323 |     if (typeof value === 'boolean') {
40324 |       return value;
40325 |     }
40326 |
40327 |     if (typeof value === 'bigint') {
40328 |       return value.toString();
40329 |     }
40330 |
40331 |     if (typeof value === 'symbol') {
40332 |       return String(value);
40333 |     }
40334 |
40335 |     if (typeof value === 'function') {
40336 |       return `[Function ${value.name || 'anonymous'}]`;
40337 |     }
40338 |
40339 |     if (depth >= 4) {
40340 |       return '[MaxDepth]';
40341 |     }
40342 |
40343 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
40344 |       return value.map((item) => this.safeJson(item, depth + 1, seen));
40345 |     }
40346 |
40347 |     if (typeof value === 'object') {
40348 |       if (seen.has(value)) {
40349 |         return '[Circular]';
40350 |       }
40351 |
40352 |       seen.add(value);
40353 |
40354 |       const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
40355 |       const result: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
40356 |
40357 |       for (const [key, item] of Object.entries(record)) {
40358 |         result[key] = this.safeJson(item, depth + 1, seen);
40359 |       }
40360 |
40361 |       seen.delete(value);
40362 |
40363 |       return result;
40364 |     }
40365 |
40366 |     return String(value);
40367 |   }
40368 |
40369 |   private removeUndefined(
40370 |     payload: Record<string, JsonValue | undefined>,
40371 |   ): Record<string, JsonValue> {
40372 |     const cleanPayload: Record<string, JsonValue> = {};
40373 |
40374 |     for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(payload)) {
40375 |       if (value !== undefined) {
40376 |         cleanPayload[key] = value;
40377 |       }
40378 |     }
40379 |
40380 |     return cleanPayload;
40381 |   }
40382 | }

40386 |
40387 | ~~~text
40388 | import {
40389 |   CanActivate,
40390 |   ExecutionContext,
40391 |   Injectable,
40392 |   UnauthorizedException,
40393 | } from '@nestjs/common';
40394 | import { timingSafeEqual } from 'crypto';
40395 |
40396 | @Injectable()
40397 | export class MetricsAuthGuard implements CanActivate {
40398 |   canActivate(context: ExecutionContext): boolean {
40399 |     const request = context.switchToHttp().getRequest();
40400 |
40401 |     const nodeEnv = process.env.NODE_ENV || 'development';
40402 |     const metricsPublic = process.env.METRICS_PUBLIC === 'true';
40403 |
40404 |     if (nodeEnv !== 'production' && metricsPublic) {
40405 |       return true;
40406 |     }
40407 |
40408 |     const expectedToken = process.env.METRICS_TOKEN;
40409 |
40410 |     if (!expectedToken) {
40411 |       throw new UnauthorizedException('METRICS_TOKEN nao configurado.');
40412 |     }
40413 |
40414 |     const headerToken = request.headers?.['x-metrics-token'];
40415 |     const authorization = request.headers?.authorization;
40416 |
40417 |     const bearerToken =
40418 |       typeof authorization === 'string' && authorization.startsWith('Bearer ')
40419 |         ? authorization.slice('Bearer '.length).trim()
40420 |         : undefined;
40421 |
40422 |     const receivedToken =
40423 |       typeof headerToken === 'string'
40424 |         ? headerToken
40425 |         : Array.isArray(headerToken)
40426 |           ? headerToken[0]
40427 |           : bearerToken;
40428 |
40429 |     if (!receivedToken || !this.safeTokenEquals(receivedToken, expectedToken)) {
40430 |       throw new UnauthorizedException('Token de metricas invalido.');
40431 |     }
40432 |
40433 |     return true;
40434 |   }
40435 |
40436 |   private safeTokenEquals(receivedToken: string, expectedToken: string): boolean {
40437 |     const received = Buffer.from(receivedToken);
40438 |     const expected = Buffer.from(expectedToken);
40439 |
40440 |     if (received.length !== expected.length) {
40441 |       return false;
40442 |     }
40443 |
40444 |     return timingSafeEqual(received, expected);
40445 |   }
40446 | }

40452 | import { Controller, Get, Header, UseGuards } from '@nestjs/common';
40453 |
40454 | import { HealthService } from '../../modules/health/health.service';
40455 | import { MetricsService } from './metrics.service';
40456 | import { MetricsAuthGuard } from './guards/metrics-auth.guard';
40457 |
40458 | type DependencyMetric = {
40459 |   name: string;
40460 |   critical: boolean;
40461 |   healthy: number;
40462 |   latencySeconds: number;
40463 |   status: string;
40464 |   details?: Record<string, unknown>;
40465 | };
40466 |
40467 | @Controller()
40468 | export class MetricsController {
40469 |   constructor(
40470 |     private readonly metricsService: MetricsService,
40471 |     private readonly healthService: HealthService,
40472 |   ) {}
40473 |
40474 |   @UseGuards(MetricsAuthGuard)
40475 |   @Get('metrics')
40476 |   @Header('Content-Type', 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8')
40477 |   async getMetrics(): Promise<string> {
40478 |     const baseMetrics = this.metricsService.renderPrometheusMetrics();
40479 |     const dependencyMetrics = await this.renderDependencyMetrics();
40480 |
40481 |     return `${baseMetrics}\n${dependencyMetrics}\n`;
40482 |   }
40483 |
40484 |   private async renderDependencyMetrics(): Promise<string> {
40485 |     const checks = await Promise.all([
40486 |       this.runDependencyCheck('database', true, () =>
40487 |         this.healthService.checkDatabase(),
40488 |       ),
40489 |       this.runDependencyCheck('redis', true, () =>
40490 |         this.healthService.checkRedis(),
40491 |       ),
40492 |       this.runDependencyCheck('bullmq', true, () =>
40493 |         this.healthService.checkQueues(),
40494 |       ),
40495 |       this.runDependencyCheck('scheduler', false, () =>
40496 |         this.healthService.checkScheduler(),
40497 |       ),
40498 |     ]);
40499 |
40500 |     const lines: string[] = [];
40501 |
40502 |     lines.push(
40503 |       '# HELP beauty_core_dependency_health Dependency health status. 1 means healthy, 0 means unhealthy.',
40504 |     );
40505 |     lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_dependency_health gauge');
40506 |
40507 |     for (const check of checks) {
40508 |       lines.push(
40509 |         `beauty_core_dependency_health{${this.formatLabels({
40510 |           dependency: check.name,
40511 |           critical: String(check.critical),
40512 |           status: check.status,
40513 |         })}} ${check.healthy}`,
40514 |       );
40515 |     }
40516 |
40517 |     lines.push('');
40518 |     lines.push(
40519 |       '# HELP beauty_core_dependency_latency_seconds Dependency health check latency in seconds.',
40520 |     );
40521 |     lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_dependency_latency_seconds gauge');
40522 |
40523 |     for (const check of checks) {
40524 |       lines.push(
40525 |         `beauty_core_dependency_latency_seconds{${this.formatLabels({
40526 |           dependency: check.name,
40527 |           critical: String(check.critical),
40528 |         })}} ${check.latencySeconds}`,
40529 |       );
40530 |     }
40531 |
40532 |     lines.push('');
40533 |
40534 |     const bullmq = checks.find((check) => check.name === 'bullmq');
40535 |
40536 |     if (bullmq?.details) {
40537 |       lines.push(
40538 |         '# HELP beauty_core_queue_jobs BullMQ jobs by queue and state.',
40539 |       );
40540 |       lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_queue_jobs gauge');
40541 |
40542 |       const queues = this.readQueuesFromDetails(bullmq.details);
40543 |
40544 |       for (const [queueName, counts] of Object.entries(queues)) {
40545 |         for (const [state, value] of Object.entries(counts)) {
40546 |           if (typeof value !== 'number') {
40547 |             continue;
40548 |           }
40549 |
40550 |           lines.push(
40551 |             `beauty_core_queue_jobs{${this.formatLabels({
40552 |               queue: queueName,
40553 |               state,
40554 |             })}} ${value}`,
40555 |           );
40556 |         }
40557 |       }
40558 |     }
40559 |
40560 |     return lines.join('\n');
40561 |   }
40562 |
40563 |   private async runDependencyCheck(
40564 |     name: string,
40565 |     critical: boolean,
40566 |     fn: () => Promise<unknown>,
40567 |   ): Promise<DependencyMetric> {
40568 |     const startedAt = process.hrtime.bigint();
40569 |
40570 |     try {
40571 |       const result = await fn();
40572 |       const status = this.readStatus(result);
40573 |       const healthy = this.isHealthyStatus(status) ? 1 : 0;
40574 |
40575 |       return {
40576 |         name,
40577 |         critical,
40578 |         healthy,
40579 |         status,
40580 |         latencySeconds: this.elapsedSeconds(startedAt),
40581 |         details: this.toRecord(result),
40582 |       };
40583 |     } catch (error) {
40584 |       return {
40585 |         name,
40586 |         critical,
40587 |         healthy: 0,
40588 |         status: 'error',
40589 |         latencySeconds: this.elapsedSeconds(startedAt),
40590 |         details: {
40591 |           error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
40592 |         },
40593 |       };
40594 |     }
40595 |   }
40596 |
40597 |   private readStatus(result: unknown): string {
40598 |     if (!result || typeof result !== 'object') {
40599 |       return 'unknown';
40600 |     }
40601 |
40602 |     const status = (result as Record<string, unknown>).status;
40603 |
40604 |     return String(status ?? 'unknown').toLowerCase();
40605 |   }
40606 |
40607 |   private isHealthyStatus(status: string): boolean {
40608 |     return status === 'ok' || status === 'healthy';
40609 |   }
40610 |
40611 |   private toRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
40612 |     if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
40613 |       return {
40614 |         value: value ?? null,
40615 |       };
40616 |     }
40617 |
40618 |     return value as Record<string, unknown>;
40619 |   }
40620 |
40621 |   private readQueuesFromDetails(
40622 |     details: Record<string, unknown>,
40623 |   ): Record<string, Record<string, number>> {
40624 |     const queues = details.queues;
40625 |
40626 |     if (!queues || typeof queues !== 'object' || Array.isArray(queues)) {
40627 |       return {};
40628 |     }
40629 |
40630 |     return queues as Record<string, Record<string, number>>;
40631 |   }
40632 |
40633 |   private elapsedSeconds(startedAt: bigint): number {
40634 |     return Number(
40635 |       (Number(process.hrtime.bigint() - startedAt) / 1_000_000_000).toFixed(6),
40636 |     );
40637 |   }
40638 |
40639 |   private formatLabels(labels: Record<string, string>): string {
40640 |     return Object.entries(labels)
40641 |       .map(([key, value]) => `${key}="${this.escapeLabelValue(value)}"`)
40642 |       .join(',');
40643 |   }
40644 |
40645 |   private escapeLabelValue(value: string): string {
40646 |     return value.replace(/\\/g, '\\\\').replace(/"/g, '\\"').replace(/\n/g, '\\n');
40647 |   }
40648 | }

40655 | import { Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
40656 |
40657 | type HttpRequestLabels = {
40658 |   method: string;
40659 |   route: string;
40660 |   statusCode: string;
40661 | };
40662 |
40663 | type HttpErrorLabels = HttpRequestLabels & {
40664 |   errorFamily: string;
40665 | };
40666 |
40667 | type HistogramState = {
40668 |   labels: HttpRequestLabels;
40669 |   buckets: Map<number, number>;
40670 |   sum: number;
40671 |   count: number;
40672 | };
40673 |
40674 | @Injectable()
40675 | export class MetricsService {
40676 |   private readonly serviceName = 'beauty-core-api';
40677 |   private readonly environment = process.env.NODE_ENV ?? 'development';
40678 |   private readonly version = process.env.APP_VERSION ?? '1.0.0';
40679 |
40680 |   private readonly histogramBuckets = [
40681 |     0.005,
40682 |     0.01,
40683 |     0.025,
40684 |     0.05,
40685 |     0.1,
40686 |     0.25,
40687 |     0.5,
40688 |     1,
40689 |     2.5,
40690 |     5,
40691 |     10,
40692 |   ];
40693 |
40694 |   private readonly httpRequests = new Map<string, number>();
40695 |   private readonly httpErrors = new Map<string, number>();
40696 |   private readonly httpRequestDurations = new Map<string, HistogramState>();
40697 |
40698 |   observeHttpRequest(params: {
40699 |     method: string;
40700 |     route: string;
40701 |     statusCode: number;
40702 |     durationMs: number;
40703 |   }): void {
40704 |     const labels: HttpRequestLabels = {
40705 |       method: this.normalizeLabelValue(params.method || 'UNKNOWN'),
40706 |       route: this.normalizeRoute(params.route || 'unknown'),
40707 |       statusCode: String(params.statusCode || 0),
40708 |     };
40709 |
40710 |     const durationSeconds = Math.max(params.durationMs, 0) / 1000;
40711 |
40712 |     this.increment(this.httpRequests, this.createHttpRequestKey(labels));
40713 |     this.observeDuration(labels, durationSeconds);
40714 |
40715 |     if (params.statusCode >= 400) {
40716 |       const errorLabels: HttpErrorLabels = {
40717 |         ...labels,
40718 |         errorFamily: `${Math.floor(params.statusCode / 100)}xx`,
40719 |       };
40720 |
40721 |       this.increment(this.httpErrors, this.createHttpErrorKey(errorLabels));
40722 |     }
40723 |   }
40724 |
40725 |   renderPrometheusMetrics(): string {
40726 |     const lines: string[] = [];
40727 |
40728 |     lines.push('# HELP beauty_core_app_info Beauty Core application information.');
40729 |     lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_app_info gauge');
40730 |     lines.push(
40731 |       `beauty_core_app_info{${this.formatLabels({
40732 |         service: this.serviceName,
40733 |         environment: this.environment,
40734 |         version: this.version,
40735 |       })}} 1`,
40736 |     );
40737 |
40738 |     lines.push('');
40739 |     lines.push('# HELP beauty_core_http_requests_total Total HTTP requests received by the API.');
40740 |     lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_http_requests_total counter');
40741 |
40742 |     for (const [key, value] of [...this.httpRequests.entries()].sort()) {
40743 |       const labels = this.parseHttpRequestKey(key);
40744 |       lines.push(
40745 |         `beauty_core_http_requests_total{${this.formatLabels({
40746 |           method: labels.method,
40747 |           route: labels.route,
40748 |           status_code: labels.statusCode,
40749 |         })}} ${value}`,
40750 |       );
40751 |     }
40752 |
40753 |     lines.push('');
40754 |     lines.push('# HELP beauty_core_http_errors_total Total HTTP error responses by status code.');
40755 |     lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_http_errors_total counter');
40756 |
40757 |     for (const [key, value] of [...this.httpErrors.entries()].sort()) {
40758 |       const labels = this.parseHttpErrorKey(key);
40759 |       lines.push(
40760 |         `beauty_core_http_errors_total{${this.formatLabels({
40761 |           method: labels.method,
40762 |           route: labels.route,
40763 |           status_code: labels.statusCode,
40764 |           error_family: labels.errorFamily,
40765 |         })}} ${value}`,
40766 |       );
40767 |     }
40768 |
40769 |     lines.push('');
40770 |     lines.push('# HELP beauty_core_http_request_duration_seconds HTTP request duration in seconds.');
40771 |     lines.push('# TYPE beauty_core_http_request_duration_seconds histogram');
40772 |
40773 |     for (const [, state] of [...this.httpRequestDurations.entries()].sort()) {
40774 |       for (const bucket of this.histogramBuckets) {
40775 |         lines.push(
40776 |           `beauty_core_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{${this.formatLabels({
40777 |             method: state.labels.method,
40778 |             route: state.labels.route,
40779 |             status_code: state.labels.statusCode,
40780 |             le: String(bucket),
40781 |           })}} ${state.buckets.get(bucket) ?? 0}`,
40782 |         );
40783 |       }
40784 |
40785 |       lines.push(
40786 |         `beauty_core_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{${this.formatLabels({
40787 |           method: state.labels.method,
40788 |           route: state.labels.route,
40789 |           status_code: state.labels.statusCode,
40790 |           le: '+Inf',
40791 |         })}} ${state.count}`,
40792 |       );
40793 |
40794 |       lines.push(
40795 |         `beauty_core_http_request_duration_seconds_sum{${this.formatLabels({
40796 |           method: state.labels.method,
40797 |           route: state.labels.route,
40798 |           status_code: state.labels.statusCode,
40799 |         })}} ${state.sum.toFixed(6)}`,
40800 |       );
40801 |
40802 |       lines.push(
40803 |         `beauty_core_http_request_duration_seconds_count{${this.formatLabels({
40804 |           method: state.labels.method,
40805 |           route: state.labels.route,
40806 |           status_code: state.labels.statusCode,
40807 |         })}} ${state.count}`,
40808 |       );
40809 |     }
40810 |
40811 |     lines.push('');
40812 |
40813 |     return `${lines.join('\n')}\n`;
40814 |   }
40815 |
40816 |   getContentType(): string {
40817 |     return 'text/plain; version=0.0.4; charset=utf-8';
40818 |   }
40819 |
40820 |   private observeDuration(
40821 |     labels: HttpRequestLabels,
40822 |     durationSeconds: number,
40823 |   ): void {
40824 |     const key = this.createHttpRequestKey(labels);
40825 |
40826 |     let state = this.httpRequestDurations.get(key);
40827 |
40828 |     if (!state) {
40829 |       state = {
40830 |         labels,
40831 |         buckets: new Map(this.histogramBuckets.map((bucket) => [bucket, 0])),
40832 |         sum: 0,
40833 |         count: 0,
40834 |       };
40835 |
40836 |       this.httpRequestDurations.set(key, state);
40837 |     }
40838 |
40839 |     state.count += 1;
40840 |     state.sum += durationSeconds;
40841 |
40842 |     for (const bucket of this.histogramBuckets) {
40843 |       if (durationSeconds <= bucket) {
40844 |         state.buckets.set(bucket, (state.buckets.get(bucket) ?? 0) + 1);
40845 |       }
40846 |     }
40847 |   }
40848 |
40849 |   private increment(map: Map<string, number>, key: string): void {
40850 |     map.set(key, (map.get(key) ?? 0) + 1);
40851 |   }
40852 |
40853 |   private createHttpRequestKey(labels: HttpRequestLabels): string {
40854 |     return [
40855 |       labels.method,
40856 |       labels.route,
40857 |       labels.statusCode,
40858 |     ].join('|');
40859 |   }
40860 |
40861 |   private createHttpErrorKey(labels: HttpErrorLabels): string {
40862 |     return [
40863 |       labels.method,
40864 |       labels.route,
40865 |       labels.statusCode,
40866 |       labels.errorFamily,
40867 |     ].join('|');
40868 |   }
40869 |
40870 |   private parseHttpRequestKey(key: string): HttpRequestLabels {
40871 |     const [method, route, statusCode] = key.split('|');
40872 |
40873 |     return {
40874 |       method,
40875 |       route,
40876 |       statusCode,
40877 |     };
40878 |   }
40879 |
40880 |   private parseHttpErrorKey(key: string): HttpErrorLabels {
40881 |     const [method, route, statusCode, errorFamily] = key.split('|');
40882 |
40883 |     return {
40884 |       method,
40885 |       route,
40886 |       statusCode,
40887 |       errorFamily,
40888 |     };
40889 |   }
40890 |
40891 |   private normalizeRoute(route: string): string {
40892 |     return route
40893 |       .replace(/\/+/g, '/')
40894 |       .replace(/\?.*$/, '')
40895 |       .trim() || 'unknown';
40896 |   }
40897 |
40898 |   private normalizeLabelValue(value: string): string {
40899 |     return String(value || 'unknown').trim() || 'unknown';
40900 |   }
40901 |
40902 |   private formatLabels(labels: Record<string, string>): string {
40903 |     return Object.entries(labels)
40904 |       .map(([key, value]) => `${key}="${this.escapeLabelValue(value)}"`)
40905 |       .join(',');
40906 |   }
40907 |
40908 |   private escapeLabelValue(value: string): string {
40909 |     return String(value)
40910 |       .replace(/\\/g, '\\\\')
40911 |       .replace(/\n/g, '\\n')
40912 |       .replace(/"/g, '\\"');
40913 |   }
40914 | }

41171 |           'fidelidade',

41185 |

41188 |         'movimentacaoFinanceira',
41189 |         'pagamentoFinanceiro',
41190 |         'comissaoProfissional',
41191 |       ],
41192 |       where,

41194 |
41195 |     const payload = {

41198 |       empresaId,
41199 |       perfil: this.removeTechnicalSecrets(cliente),
41200 |       agendamentos,

41235 |   async anonimizarCliente(clienteId: string, request: LgpdRequestContext) {
41236 |     const cliente = await this.getClienteOrThrow(clienteId, request);
41237 |     const empresaId = cliente.empresaId as string;
41238 |     const token = this.createAnonToken(clienteId);
41239 |
41240 |     const data = this.buildClienteAnonData(cliente, token, clienteId);
41241 |
41242 |     if (Object.keys(data).length === 0) {
41243 |       throw new ForbiddenException(
41244 |         'Nenhum campo anonimizavel foi encontrado no modelo Cliente.',
41245 |       );
41246 |     }
41247 |
41248 |     const clienteAnonimizado = await (this.prisma as any).cliente.update({
41249 |       where: { id: clienteId },
41250 |       data,
41251 |     });
41252 |
41253 |     const relatedUpdates = await this.anonimizarDadosRelacionados(
41254 |       clienteId,
41255 |       empresaId,
41256 |       token,
41257 |       data,
41258 |     );
41259 |
41260 |     await this.registrarAuditoria({
41261 |       acao: 'LGPD_ANONIMIZACAO',
41262 |       clienteId,
41263 |       empresaId,
41264 |       request,
41265 |       dadosAntes: this.maskClienteForAudit(cliente),
41266 |       dadosDepois: this.maskClienteForAudit(clienteAnonimizado),
41267 |       mensagem:
41268 |         'Anonimizacao LGPD de cliente realizada com preservacao de integridade financeira e auditoria.',
41269 |     });
41270 |
41271 |     return {
41272 |       success: true,
41273 |       clienteId,
41274 |       empresaId,
41275 |       anonimizadoEm: new Date().toISOString(),
41276 |       camposAnonimizados: Object.keys(data),
41277 |       relacionamentosAnonimizados: relatedUpdates,
41278 |       observacao:
41279 |         'Movimentacoes financeiras, vinculos operacionais e auditoria historica foram preservados.',
41280 |     };
41281 |   }

41283 |   private buildClienteAnonData(
41284 |     cliente: Record<string, unknown>,
41285 |     token: string,
41286 |     clienteId: string,
41287 |   ) {
41288 |     const data: Record<string, unknown> = {};
41289 |     const anonPhone = 'anon-' + token;
41290 |     const anonEmail = 'cliente-' + token + '@anonimizado.local';
41291 |     const anonText = 'ANONIMIZADO';
41292 |
41293 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'nome', 'Cliente anonimizado ' + token);
41294 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'telefone', anonPhone);
41295 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'email', anonEmail);
41296 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'cpf', this.createNumericAnonValue(clienteId, 11));
41297 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'documento', 'anon-' + token);
41298 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'dataNascimento', new Date('1900-01-01T00:00:00.000Z'));
41299 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'endereco', anonText);
41300 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'logradouro', anonText);
41301 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'numero', anonText);
41302 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'bairro', anonText);
41303 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'cidade', anonText);
41304 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'cep', anonText);
41305 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'complemento', anonText);
41306 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'observacoes', anonText);
41307 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'whatsapp', anonPhone);
41308 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'fotoUrl', null);
41309 |     this.setIfExists(cliente, data, 'avatarUrl', null);
41310 |
41311 |     return data;
41312 |   }

41325 |   private async anonimizarDadosRelacionados(
41326 |     clienteId: string,
41327 |     empresaId: string,
41328 |     token: string,
41329 |     clienteData: Record<string, unknown>,

41334 |
41335 |     if (codigoDelegate?.updateMany) {
41336 |       try {
41337 |         const result = await codigoDelegate.updateMany({
41338 |           where: { clienteId, empresaId },
41339 |           data: {
41340 |             telefone:
41341 |               typeof clienteData.telefone === 'string'
41342 |                 ? clienteData.telefone
41343 |                 : 'anon-' + token,
41344 |             codigo: 'HASHED',
41345 |             codigoHash: null,
41346 |             usado: true,
41347 |           },
41348 |         });
41349 |
41350 |         updates.codigoAcessoCliente = result?.count ?? 0;
41351 |       } catch {

41353 |       }

41359 |   private async getClienteOrThrow(
41360 |     clienteId: string,

41365 |
41366 |     const where = isSuperAdmin
41367 |       ? { id: clienteId }
41368 |       : {
41369 |           id: clienteId,
41370 |           empresaId,
41371 |         };
41372 |
41373 |     const cliente = await (this.prisma as any).cliente.findFirst({
41374 |       where,
41375 |     });
41376 |

41379 |     }
41380 |
41381 |     if (!isSuperAdmin && cliente.empresaId !== empresaId) {
41382 |       throw new ForbiddenException(

41384 |       );

41390 |   private async findManySafe(
41391 |     modelName: string,
41392 |     where: Record<string, unknown>,
41393 |   ): Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]> {
41394 |     const delegate = (this.prisma as any)[modelName];
41395 |
41396 |     if (!delegate || typeof delegate.findMany !== 'function') {
41397 |       return [];
41398 |     }
41399 |
41400 |     try {
41401 |       const rows = await delegate.findMany({
41402 |         where,
41403 |         orderBy: this.safeOrderBy(modelName),
41404 |         take: this.exportTakeLimit(),
41405 |       });
41406 |
41407 |       return this.sanitizeRows(rows);
41408 |     } catch {
41409 |       try {
41410 |         const rows = await delegate.findMany({
41411 |           where,
41412 |           take: this.exportTakeLimit(),
41413 |         });
41414 |
41415 |         return this.sanitizeRows(rows);
41416 |       } catch {
41417 |         return [];
41418 |       }
41419 |     }
41420 |   }
41421 |
41422 |   private async findManyFromModels(
41423 |     modelNames: string[],
41424 |     where: Record<string, unknown>,
41425 |   ): Promise<Record<string, Record<string, unknown>[]>> {
41426 |     const result: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>[]> = {};
41427 |
41428 |     for (const modelName of modelNames) {
41429 |       const rows = await this.findManySafe(modelName, where);
41430 |
41431 |       if (rows.length > 0) {
41432 |         result[modelName] = rows;
41433 |       }
41434 |     }
41435 |
41436 |     return result;
41437 |   }
41438 |
41439 |   private sanitizeRows(rows: Record<string, unknown>[]) {
41440 |     return rows.map((row) => this.removeTechnicalSecrets(row));
41441 |   }
41442 |
41443 |   private exportTakeLimit() {
41444 |     const value = Number(process.env.LGPD_EXPORT_MAX_ITEMS ?? 5000);
41445 |
41446 |     if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value <= 0) {
41447 |       return 5000;
41448 |     }
41449 |
41450 |     return Math.min(Math.floor(value), 10000);
41451 |   }
41452 |   private safeOrderBy(_modelName: string) {
41453 |     return {
41454 |       createdAt: 'desc',
41455 |     };
41456 |   }
41457 |
41458 |   private isSuperAdmin(request: LgpdRequestContext): boolean {
41459 |     return request.user?.role === 'SUPER_ADMIN';
41460 |   }
41461 |
41462 |   private getEmpresaId(request: LgpdRequestContext): string | null {
41463 |     return request.user?.empresaId ?? null;
41464 |   }
41465 |
41466 |   private getUsuarioId(request: LgpdRequestContext): string | null {
41467 |     return (
41468 |       request.user?.id ??
41469 |       request.user?.sub ??
41470 |       request.user?.usuarioId ??
41471 |       null
41472 |     );
41473 |   }
41474 |
41475 |   private getUserAgent(request: LgpdRequestContext): string | null {
41476 |     const value = request.headers?.['user-agent'];
41477 |
41478 |     if (Array.isArray(value)) {
41479 |       return value.join(' ');
41480 |     }
41481 |
41482 |     return value ?? null;
41483 |   }
41484 |
41485 |   private createAnonToken(clienteId: string): string {
41486 |     const base = clienteId.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/g, '').slice(0, 8);
41487 |     const suffix = Date.now().toString().slice(-6);
41488 |
41489 |     return (base || 'cliente') + suffix;
41490 |   }
41491 |
41492 |   private createNumericAnonValue(input: string, length: number): string {
41493 |     let seed = 0;
41494 |
41495 |     for (const char of input) {
41496 |       seed = (seed + char.charCodeAt(0) * 17) % 1000000007;
41497 |     }
41498 |
41499 |     let output = '';
41500 |
41501 |     for (let index = 0; index < length; index++) {
41502 |       seed = (seed * 1103515245 + 12345) % 2147483647;
41503 |       output += String(seed % 10);
41504 |     }
41505 |
41506 |     return output.padStart(length, '0').slice(0, length);
41507 |   }

41509 |   private removeTechnicalSecrets(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
41510 |     const technicalFields = new Set([
41511 |       'senha',
41512 |       'password',
41513 |       'senhaHash',
41514 |       'hashSenha',
41515 |       'refreshToken',
41516 |       'refreshTokenHash',
41517 |       'accessToken',
41518 |       'token',
41519 |       'codigo',
41520 |       'codigoHash',
41521 |       'codigoAcesso',
41522 |       'otp',
41523 |       'secret',
41524 |       'clientSecret',
41525 |       'apiKey',
41526 |       'authorization',
41527 |     ]);
41528 |
41529 |     const sanitize = (value: unknown): unknown => {
41530 |       if (Array.isArray(value)) {
41531 |         return value.map((item) => sanitize(item));
41532 |       }
41533 |
41534 |       if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
41535 |         return value;
41536 |       }
41537 |
41538 |       if (value instanceof Date) {
41539 |         return value;
41540 |       }
41541 |
41542 |       const clone: Record<string, unknown> = {};
41543 |
41544 |       for (const [key, nestedValue] of Object.entries(
41545 |         value as Record<string, unknown>,
41546 |       )) {
41547 |         if (technicalFields.has(key)) {
41548 |           continue;
41549 |         }
41550 |
41551 |         clone[key] = sanitize(nestedValue);
41552 |       }
41553 |
41554 |       return clone;
41555 |     };
41556 |
41557 |     return sanitize(data) as Record<string, unknown>;
41558 |   }
41559 |
41560 |   private maskClienteForAudit(data: Record<string, unknown>) {
41561 |     return {
41562 |       id: data.id,
41563 |       empresaId: data.empresaId,
41564 |       nome: data.nome ? '[REDACTED]' : null,
41565 |       telefone: data.telefone ? '[REDACTED]' : null,
41566 |       email: data.email ? '[REDACTED]' : null,
41567 |       cpf: data.cpf ? '[REDACTED]' : null,
41568 |       dataNascimento: data.dataNascimento ? '[REDACTED]' : null,

41570 |       observacoes: data.observacoes ? '[REDACTED]' : null,

41573 |
41574 |   private async registrarAuditoria(params: {
41575 |     acao: string;
41576 |     clienteId: string;
41577 |     empresaId: string;
41578 |     request: LgpdRequestContext;
41579 |     dadosAntes?: Record<string, unknown>;
41580 |     dadosDepois?: Record<string, unknown>;
41581 |     mensagem: string;
41582 |   }) {
41583 |     const delegate = (this.prisma as any).auditoriaSistema;
41584 |
41585 |     if (!delegate || typeof delegate.create !== 'function') {
41586 |       return;
41587 |     }
41588 |
41589 |     try {
41590 |       await delegate.create({
41591 |         data: {
41592 |           empresaId: params.empresaId,
41593 |           usuarioId: this.getUsuarioId(params.request),
41594 |           clienteId: params.clienteId,
41595 |           tipoUsuario: 'ADMIN',
41596 |           acao: params.acao,
41597 |           modulo: 'LGPD',
41598 |           rota: params.request.originalUrl ?? params.request.url ?? null,
41599 |           ip: params.request.ip ?? null,
41600 |           userAgent: this.getUserAgent(params.request),
41601 |           recurso: 'Cliente',
41602 |           dadosAntes: params.dadosAntes ?? null,
41603 |           dadosDepois: params.dadosDepois ?? null,
41604 |           status: 'SUCESSO',
41605 |           mensagem: params.mensagem,
41606 |         },
41607 |       });
41608 |     } catch {
41609 |       // Operacoes LGPD nao devem falhar por indisponibilidade de auditoria.
41610 |     }
41611 |   }
41612 | }

42009 |
42010 | @Injectable()
42011 | export class AgendamentosService {
42012 |   private readonly logger = new Logger(AgendamentosService.name);
42013 |
42014 |   constructor(
42015 |     private readonly prisma: PrismaService,

42020 |
42021 |   async create(
42022 |     createAgendamentoDto: CreateAgendamentoDto,
42023 |     empresaId: string,
42024 |   ) {
42025 |     const startedAt = Date.now();
42026 |
42027 |     await this.tenantValidator.validarEmpresaAtiva(empresaId);
42028 |
42029 |     await this.validarRelacionamentosDoAgendamento(
42030 |       empresaId,
42031 |       {
42032 |         clienteId: createAgendamentoDto.clienteId,
42033 |         profissionalId: createAgendamentoDto.profissionalId,
42034 |         servicoId: createAgendamentoDto.servicoId,
42035 |         unidadeId: createAgendamentoDto.unidadeId,
42036 |       },
42037 |     );
42038 |
42039 |     const agendamento = await this.prisma.agendamento.create({
42040 |       data: {
42041 |         ...createAgendamentoDto,
42042 |         empresaId,
42043 |       },
42044 |     });
42045 |
42046 |     await this.automacoesService.processarEvento({
42047 |       empresaId,
42048 |       tipo: TipoEventoSistema.AGENDAMENTO_CRIADO,
42049 |       modulo: 'AGENDAMENTOS',
42050 |       titulo: 'Novo agendamento criado',
42051 |       mensagem: `Um novo agendamento foi criado para ${new Date(
42052 |         agendamento.dataHoraInicio,
42053 |       ).toLocaleString('pt-BR')}.`,
42054 |       referenciaId: agendamento.id,
42055 |       dados: {
42056 |         agendamentoId: agendamento.id,
42057 |         clienteId: agendamento.clienteId,
42058 |         profissionalId: agendamento.profissionalId,
42059 |         servicoId: agendamento.servicoId,
42060 |         unidadeId: agendamento.unidadeId,
42061 |         status: agendamento.status,
42062 |       },
42063 |     });
42064 |
42065 |     const tempoMs = Date.now() - startedAt;
42066 |
42067 |     this.logger.log(
42068 |       `[AGENDAMENTOS] agendamento criado empresaId=${empresaId} agendamentoId=${agendamento.id} clienteId=${agendamento.clienteId} status=SUCESSO tempoMs=${tempoMs}`,
42069 |     );
42070 |
42071 |     await this.auditoriaService.registrarCriacao({
42072 |       empresaId,
42073 |       tipoUsuario: TipoUsuarioAuditoria.SISTEMA,
42074 |       modulo: 'AGENDAMENTOS',
42075 |       recurso: 'Agendamento',
42076 |       recursoId: agendamento.id,
42077 |       clienteId: agendamento.clienteId,
42078 |       dadosDepois: {
42079 |         id: agendamento.id,
42080 |         clienteId: agendamento.clienteId,
42081 |         profissionalId: agendamento.profissionalId,
42082 |         servicoId: agendamento.servicoId,
42083 |         unidadeId: agendamento.unidadeId,
42084 |         status: agendamento.status,
42085 |         dataHoraInicio: agendamento.dataHoraInicio,
42086 |         dataHoraFim: agendamento.dataHoraFim,
42087 |       },
42088 |       metadata: {
42089 |         tempoMs,
42090 |       },
42091 |       mensagem: 'Agendamento criado com sucesso.',
42092 |     });
42093 |
42094 |     return agendamento;
42095 |   }

43457 |   private percentual(atual: number, anterior: number): number {

43460 |     }
43461 |

44587 | import {
44588 |   BadRequestException,
44589 |   Injectable,
44590 |   NotFoundException,
44591 | } from '@nestjs/common';
44592 |
44593 | import {
44594 |   Prisma,
44595 |   StatusAgendamento,
44596 |   StatusClientePacote,
44597 |   StatusNotificacao,
44598 |   TipoMovimentacaoPontos,
44599 | } from '@prisma/client';
44600 |
44601 | import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma/prisma.service';
44602 | import { PaginationDto } from '../../shared/dto/pagination.dto';
44603 | import { TenantValidatorService } from '../../shared/tenant';
44604 | import {
44605 |   buildPaginatedResponse,
44606 |   getPaginationParams,
44607 | } from '../../shared/utils/pagination.util';
44608 |
44609 | import { UpdatePerfilClienteDto } from './dto/update-perfil-cliente.dto';
44610 |
44611 | @Injectable()
44612 | export class AreaClienteService {
44613 |   constructor(
44614 |     private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
44615 |     private readonly tenantValidator: TenantValidatorService,
44616 |   ) {}
44617 |
44618 |   private async validarClientePortal(
44619 |     empresaId: string,
44620 |     clienteId: string,
44621 |   ) {
44622 |     const clienteValidado =
44623 |       await this.tenantValidator.validarCliente(empresaId, clienteId);
44624 |
44625 |     if (!clienteValidado.ativoPortal) {
44626 |       throw new NotFoundException(
44627 |         'Cliente nÃ£o encontrado ou portal desativado.',
44628 |       );
44629 |     }
44630 |
44631 |     const cliente = await this.prisma.cliente.findFirst({
44632 |       where: {
44633 |         id: clienteId,
44634 |         empresaId,
44635 |         ativo: true,
44636 |         ativoPortal: true,
44637 |       },
44638 |     });
44639 |
44640 |     if (!cliente) {
44641 |       throw new NotFoundException(
44642 |         'Cliente nÃ£o encontrado ou portal desativado.',
44643 |       );
44644 |     }
44645 |
44646 |     return cliente;
44647 |   }
44648 |
44649 |   async perfil(empresaId: string, clienteId: string) {
44650 |     const cliente = await this.validarClientePortal(
44651 |       empresaId,
44652 |       clienteId,
44653 |     );
44654 |
44655 |     const [
44656 |       fidelidade,
44657 |       nivelAtual,
44658 |       pacotesAtivos,
44659 |       quantidadeAgendamentos,
44660 |     ] = await Promise.all([
44661 |       this.prisma.fidelidade.findUnique({
44662 |         where: {
44663 |           clienteId_empresaId: {
44664 |             clienteId,
44665 |             empresaId,
44666 |           },
44667 |         },
44668 |       }),
44669 |       this.buscarNivelAtual(empresaId, clienteId),
44670 |       this.prisma.clientePacote.findMany({
44671 |         where: {
44672 |           empresaId,
44673 |           clienteId,
44674 |           status: StatusClientePacote.ATIVO,
44675 |         },
44676 |         include: {
44677 |           pacote: true,
44678 |         },
44679 |         orderBy: {
44680 |           createdAt: 'desc',
44681 |         },
44682 |         take: 20,
44683 |       }),
44684 |       this.prisma.agendamento.count({
44685 |         where: {
44686 |           empresaId,
44687 |           clienteId,
44688 |         },
44689 |       }),
44690 |     ]);
44691 |
44692 |     return {
44693 |       id: cliente.id,
44694 |       empresaId: cliente.empresaId,
44695 |       nome: cliente.nome,
44696 |       telefone: cliente.telefone,
44697 |       email: cliente.email,
44698 |       foto: cliente.foto,
44699 |       dataNascimento: cliente.dataNascimento,
44700 |       dataCadastro: cliente.createdAt,
44701 |       pontosAtuais: fidelidade?.saldoPontos ?? 0,
44702 |       nivelAtual,

44937 |         where: {

44947 |       this.prisma.nivelFidelidade.findMany({
44948 |         where: {
44949 |           empresaId,

44951 |         orderBy: {

44953 |         },

44965 |

45279 |
45280 | ~~~text
45281 | import { ForbiddenException, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
45282 | import { Arquivo } from '@prisma/client';
45283 |
45284 | interface AuthenticatedFileUser {
45285 |   sub?: string;
45286 |   id?: string;
45287 |   usuarioId?: string;
45288 |   clienteId?: string;
45289 |   empresaId?: string;
45290 |   role?: string;
45291 | }
45292 |
45293 | @Injectable()
45294 | export class ArquivoAccessPolicyService {
45295 |   assertCanAccess(user: AuthenticatedFileUser, arquivo: Arquivo): void {
45296 |     if (!user) {
45297 |       throw new ForbiddenException('Usuário não autenticado.');
45298 |     }
45299 |
45300 |     if (!user.empresaId) {
45301 |       throw new ForbiddenException('Empresa não identificada no token.');
45302 |     }
45303 |
45304 |     if (user.empresaId !== arquivo.empresaId) {
45305 |       throw new ForbiddenException('Arquivo pertence a outra empresa.');
45306 |     }
45307 |
45308 |     if (user.role === 'ADMIN' || user.role === 'GERENTE') {
45309 |       return;
45310 |     }
45311 |
45312 |     if (user.role === 'RECEPCAO') {
45313 |       return;
45314 |     }
45315 |
45316 |     if (user.role === 'PROFISSIONAL') {
45317 |       const usuarioId = user.usuarioId || user.sub || user.id;
45318 |
45319 |       if (arquivo.usuarioId && arquivo.usuarioId === usuarioId) {
45320 |         return;
45321 |       }
45322 |
45323 |       throw new ForbiddenException(
45324 |         'Profissional não tem permissão para acessar este arquivo.',
45325 |       );
45326 |     }
45327 |
45328 |     if (user.role === 'CLIENTE') {
45329 |       const clienteId = user.clienteId || user.sub || user.id;
45330 |
45331 |       if (arquivo.clienteId && arquivo.clienteId === clienteId) {
45332 |         return;
45333 |       }
45334 |
45335 |       throw new ForbiddenException(
45336 |         'Cliente não tem permissão para acessar este arquivo.',
45337 |       );
45338 |     }
45339 |
45340 |     throw new ForbiddenException('Permissão insuficiente para acessar arquivo.');
45341 |   }
45342 | }

46575 |   updatedAt: string;
46576 | }
46577 |
46578 | @Injectable()
46579 | export class ArquivosCleanupService {
46580 |   private readonly logger = new Logger(ArquivosCleanupService.name);
46581 |   private readonly baseDir = resolve(
46582 |     process.cwd(),
46583 |     process.env.UPLOADS_DIR || 'uploads',
46584 |   );
46585 |
46586 |   constructor(
46587 |     private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
46588 |     private readonly localStorage: LocalStorageService,
46589 |   ) {}
46590 |
46591 |   async gerarRelatorioArquivosOrfaos(empresaId?: string) {
46592 |     const arquivosBanco = await this.prisma.arquivo.findMany({
46593 |       where: {
46594 |         ...(empresaId ? { empresaId } : {}),
46595 |         status: {
46596 |           not: StatusArquivo.EXCLUIDO,
46597 |         },
46598 |       },
46599 |       select: {
46600 |         id: true,
46601 |         empresaId: true,
46602 |         nomeOriginal: true,
46603 |         caminho: true,
46604 |         url: true,
46605 |         visibilidade: true,
46606 |         armazenamento: true,
46607 |         privado: true,
46608 |         status: true,
46609 |         createdAt: true,
46610 |       },
46611 |     });
46612 |
46613 |     const registrosSemArquivo: Array<Record<string, unknown>> = [];
46614 |
46615 |     for (const arquivo of arquivosBanco) {
46616 |       if (!arquivo.caminho) {
46617 |         registrosSemArquivo.push({
46618 |           ...arquivo,
46619 |           motivo: 'REGISTRO_SEM_CAMINHO',
46620 |         });
46621 |
46622 |         continue;
46623 |       }
46624 |
46625 |       const existeFisicamente = await this.localStorage.exists(arquivo.caminho);
46626 |
46627 |       if (!existeFisicamente) {
46628 |         registrosSemArquivo.push({
46629 |           ...arquivo,
46630 |           motivo: 'REGISTRO_SEM_ARQUIVO_FISICO',
46631 |         });
46632 |       }
46633 |     }
46634 |
46635 |     const caminhosRegistrados = new Set(
46636 |       arquivosBanco
46637 |         .map((arquivo) => arquivo.caminho)
46638 |         .filter(Boolean)
46639 |         .map((caminho) => String(caminho).replace(/\\/g, '/')),
46640 |     );
46641 |
46642 |     const arquivosFisicos = [
46643 |       ...(await this.listarArquivosFisicos('public')),
46644 |       ...(await this.listarArquivosFisicos('private')),
46645 |     ];
46646 |
46647 |     const arquivosFisicosSemRegistro = arquivosFisicos.filter(
46648 |       (arquivo) => !caminhosRegistrados.has(arquivo.caminhoRelativo),
46649 |     );
46650 |
46651 |     return {
46652 |       empresaId: empresaId ?? null,
46653 |       totalRegistrosBanco: arquivosBanco.length,
46654 |       totalArquivosFisicosAuditados: arquivosFisicos.length,
46655 |       registrosSemArquivo: registrosSemArquivo.length,
46656 |       arquivosFisicosSemRegistro: arquivosFisicosSemRegistro.length,
46657 |       detalhes: {
46658 |         registrosSemArquivo,
46659 |         arquivosFisicosSemRegistro,
46660 |       },
46661 |       geradoEm: new Date().toISOString(),
46662 |     };
46663 |   }
46664 |
46665 |   async limparArquivosTemp(idadeMinimaHoras = 24) {
46666 |     const tempDir = resolve(this.baseDir, 'temp');
46667 |     const arquivosTemp = await this.listarArquivosFisicos('temp');
46668 |
46669 |     const agora = Date.now();
46670 |     const idadeMinimaMs = idadeMinimaHoras * 60 * 60 * 1000;
46671 |
46672 |     const removidos: ArquivoFisicoInfo[] = [];
46673 |     const ignorados: ArquivoFisicoInfo[] = [];
46674 |
46675 |     for (const arquivo of arquivosTemp) {
46676 |       const caminhoAbsoluto = resolve(this.baseDir, arquivo.caminhoRelativo);
46677 |
46678 |       if (!caminhoAbsoluto.startsWith(tempDir)) {
46679 |         ignorados.push(arquivo);
46680 |         continue;
46681 |       }
46682 |
46683 |       const idadeMs = agora - new Date(arquivo.updatedAt).getTime();
46684 |
46685 |       if (idadeMs < idadeMinimaMs) {
46686 |         ignorados.push(arquivo);
46687 |         continue;
46688 |       }
46689 |
46690 |       await unlink(caminhoAbsoluto);
46691 |       removidos.push(arquivo);
46692 |     }
46693 |
46694 |     return {
46695 |       idadeMinimaHoras,
46696 |       totalAuditados: arquivosTemp.length,
46697 |       removidos: removidos.length,
46698 |       ignorados: ignorados.length,
46699 |       detalhes: {
46700 |         removidos,
46701 |         ignorados,
46702 |       },
46703 |       executadoEm: new Date().toISOString(),
46704 |     };
46705 |   }
46706 |
46707 |   private async listarArquivosFisicos(
46708 |     subpasta: 'public' | 'private' | 'temp',
46709 |   ): Promise<ArquivoFisicoInfo[]> {
46710 |     const raiz = resolve(this.baseDir, subpasta);
46711 |
46712 |     try {
46713 |       return await this.walk(raiz);
46714 |     } catch {
46715 |       return [];
46716 |     }
46717 |   }
46718 |
46719 |   private async walk(dir: string): Promise<ArquivoFisicoInfo[]> {
46720 |     const entries = await readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
46721 |     const arquivos: ArquivoFisicoInfo[] = [];
46722 |
46723 |     for (const entry of entries) {
46724 |       const fullPath = join(dir, entry.name);
46725 |
46726 |       if (entry.isDirectory()) {
46727 |         arquivos.push(...(await this.walk(fullPath)));
46728 |         continue;
46729 |       }
46730 |
46731 |       if (!entry.isFile()) {
46732 |         continue;
46733 |       }
46734 |
46735 |       const info = await stat(fullPath);
46736 |
46737 |       arquivos.push({
46738 |         caminhoRelativo: relative(this.baseDir, fullPath).replace(/\\/g, '/'),
46739 |         tamanhoBytes: info.size,
46740 |         updatedAt: info.mtime.toISOString(),
46741 |       });
46742 |     }
46743 |
46744 |     return arquivos;
46745 |   }
46746 | }

46866 | import {
46867 |   ForbiddenException,
46868 |   Injectable,
46869 |   NotFoundException,
46870 | } from '@nestjs/common';
46871 | import { AcaoAuditoria, Arquivo, StatusArquivo, StatusAuditoria, TipoUsuarioAuditoria } from '@prisma/client';

46873 |
46874 | import { PrismaService } from '../../database/prisma/prisma.service';
46875 | import { ArquivoAccessPolicyService } from './arquivo-access-policy.service';

46877 | import { StorageFactory } from './storage/storage.factory';
46878 | import { AuditoriaService } from '../auditoria/auditoria.service';
46879 |
46880 | interface AuthenticatedFileUser {
46881 |   sub?: string;
46882 |   id?: string;
46883 |   usuarioId?: string;
46884 |   clienteId?: string;
46885 |   empresaId?: string;
46886 |   role?: string;
46887 | }
46888 |
46889 | interface DownloadResult {
46890 |   arquivo: Arquivo;
46891 |   stream: ReadStream;
46892 | }
46893 |
46894 | @Injectable()
46895 | export class ArquivosDownloadService {
46896 |   constructor(
46897 |     private readonly prisma: PrismaService,
46898 |     private readonly storageFactory: StorageFactory,
46899 |     private readonly localStorage: LocalStorageService,
46900 |     private readonly accessPolicy: ArquivoAccessPolicyService,
46901 |     private readonly auditoriaService: AuditoriaService,
46902 |   ) {}
46903 |
46904 |   async downloadProtegido(
46905 |     id: string,
46906 |     user: AuthenticatedFileUser,
46907 |   ): Promise<DownloadResult> {
46908 |     if (!user?.empresaId) {
46909 |       throw new ForbiddenException('Empresa não identificada no token.');
46910 |     }
46911 |
46912 |     const arquivo = await this.prisma.arquivo.findFirst({
46913 |       where: {
46914 |         id,
46915 |         empresaId: user.empresaId,
46916 |         status: StatusArquivo.ATIVO,
46917 |       },
46918 |     });
46919 |
46920 |     if (!arquivo) {
46921 |       throw new NotFoundException('Arquivo não encontrado.');
46922 |     }
46923 |
46924 |     this.accessPolicy.assertCanAccess(user, arquivo);
46925 |
46926 |     const stream = await this.criarStreamComValidacao(arquivo);
46927 |
46928 |     await this.incrementarDownload(arquivo.id, arquivo.empresaId);
46929 |
46930 |     await this.registrarAuditoriaArquivo({
46931 |       arquivo,
46932 |       user,
46933 |       acao: 'DOWNLOAD_ARQUIVO' as AcaoAuditoria,
46934 |       origem: 'download_protegido',
46935 |       mensagem: 'Download protegido de arquivo realizado com sucesso.',
46936 |     });
46937 |
46938 |     return {
46939 |       arquivo,
46940 |       stream,
46941 |     };
46942 |   }
46943 |
46944 |   async gerarSignedUrl(id: string, user: AuthenticatedFileUser) {
46945 |     if (!user?.empresaId) {
46946 |       throw new ForbiddenException('Empresa não identificada no token.');
46947 |     }
46948 |
46949 |     const arquivo = await this.prisma.arquivo.findFirst({
46950 |       where: {
46951 |         id,
46952 |         empresaId: user.empresaId,
46953 |         status: StatusArquivo.ATIVO,
46954 |       },
46955 |     });
46956 |
46957 |     if (!arquivo) {
46958 |       throw new NotFoundException('Arquivo não encontrado.');
46959 |     }
46960 |
46961 |     this.accessPolicy.assertCanAccess(user, arquivo);
46962 |
46963 |     const expiresIn = Number(process.env.SIGNED_URL_EXPIRATION || 300);
46964 |
46965 |     const storage = this.storageFactory.getProvider();
46966 |
46967 |     const signedUrl = await storage.generateSignedUrl(
46968 |       arquivo.id,
46969 |       arquivo.empresaId,
46970 |       expiresIn,
46971 |     );
46972 |
46973 |     await this.registrarAuditoriaArquivo({
46974 |       arquivo,
46975 |       user,
46976 |       acao: 'URL_ASSINADA' as AcaoAuditoria,
46977 |       origem: 'signed_url',
46978 |       mensagem: 'URL assinada gerada com sucesso.',
46979 |     });
46980 |
46981 |     return signedUrl;
46982 |   }
46983 |
46984 |   async downloadPorSignedToken(token: string): Promise<DownloadResult> {
46985 |     const payload = this.localStorage.validateSignedToken(token);
46986 |
46987 |     const arquivo = await this.prisma.arquivo.findFirst({
46988 |       where: {
46989 |         id: payload.arquivoId,
46990 |         empresaId: payload.empresaId,
46991 |         status: StatusArquivo.ATIVO,
46992 |       },
46993 |     });
46994 |
46995 |     if (!arquivo) {
46996 |       throw new NotFoundException('Arquivo não encontrado.');
46997 |     }
46998 |
46999 |     const stream = await this.criarStreamComValidacao(arquivo);
47000 |
47001 |     await this.incrementarDownload(arquivo.id, arquivo.empresaId);
47002 |
47003 |     await this.registrarAuditoriaArquivo({
47004 |       arquivo,
47005 |       acao: 'DOWNLOAD_ARQUIVO' as AcaoAuditoria,
47006 |       origem: 'download_signed_url',
47007 |       mensagem: 'Download por URL assinada realizado com sucesso.',
47008 |     });
47009 |
47010 |     return {
47011 |       arquivo,
47012 |       stream,
47013 |     };
47014 |   }
47015 |
47016 |   private async criarStreamComValidacao(arquivo: Arquivo): Promise<ReadStream> {
47017 |     if (!arquivo.caminho) {
47018 |       throw new NotFoundException('Caminho físico do arquivo não encontrado.');
47019 |     }
47020 |
47021 |     const storage = this.storageFactory.getProvider();
47022 |
47023 |     const existe = await storage.exists(arquivo.caminho);
47024 |
47025 |     if (!existe) {
47026 |       throw new NotFoundException('Arquivo físico não encontrado.');
47027 |     }
47028 |
47029 |     return storage.download(arquivo.caminho);
47030 |   }
47031 |
47032 |   private async incrementarDownload(id: string, empresaId: string) {
47033 |     await this.prisma.arquivo.updateMany({
47034 |       where: {
47035 |         id,
47036 |         empresaId,
47037 |       },
47038 |       data: {
47039 |         downloadCount: {
47040 |           increment: 1,
47041 |         },
47042 |         ultimoDownloadEm: new Date(),
47043 |       },
47044 |     });
47045 |   }
47046 |

47064 |           : undefined,

47076 |         visibilidade: params.arquivo.visibilidade,
47077 |         armazenamento: params.arquivo.armazenamento,
47078 |         privado: params.arquivo.privado,
47079 |         checksum: params.arquivo.checksum,
